milestones.title: Core App, API, Automated Tests, and Deployment

criteria.text: GET /health on the deployed HTTPS site returns HTTP 200 with JSON status ok.
GET /api/tasks returns a JSON list of tasks and POST /api/tasks creates a new task.
Entering text in input 'New task' and clicking 'Add' adds the task to the list.
Ticking the checkbox labelled with the task title marks the task as completed.
Automated tests run and pass when executing npm test.
Repository contains package.json with test script configured for npm test.
Submitting an empty title shows the error message 'Title is required'.
Clicking filter buttons 'All', 'Active', and 'Completed' filters the displayed tasks correctly.
README.md file exists in the repository with instructions on how to run the application.

questions.question: Do tasks need to persist across application restarts or server redeployments?
questions.why: In-memory storage resets on restart; if persistence to disk or file is required, it adds scope to the data layer.

criteria.text: README.md contains instructions for running the local server and running tests.
npm test passes for menu listing and pricing display component tests.
Visiting the homepage displays header element 'Fresh Bakery Menu' and displays baked goods with item names and prices.
npm test passes for cart calculations and order submission validation.
Clicking 'Add to Cart' next to a menu item updates the header badge to display 'Cart (1)'.
Submitting the order checkout form displays confirmation message 'Order Confirmed'.
Navigating to '/admin' allows updating a menu item title and saving changes.
Viewing the site on a mobile device display shows a collapsable navigation bar toggle labeled 'Menu'.
The website visual layout looks modern, clean, and styled appropriately for a bakery brand.

questions.question: Do you require online payment processing (e.g., Stripe/Credit Card) or is pay-upon-pickup sufficient?
questions.why: Integrating a payment gateway adds authentication and payment SDK setup scope.

questions.question: Do you have existing photos and menu item details ready to upload, or will placeholder content be used initially?
questions.why: Preparing custom photography and assets can impact content integration timeline.
